summary: Build farm budgets, value chain maps, and bankable agribusiness plans in 5 days. Learn practical tools for commercial farming success.
lede: Agribusiness management links farm production, costs, markets, and finance to support commercial decisions. For commercial farm managers, owners, finance staff, and advisers, this training provides practical ways to prepare seasonal budgets and cash-flow plans, track production and profitability through farm records and gross-margin analysis, map value chains and channel margins, and assess market and climate-related risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, finance, advise, or scale commercial farming and agribusiness operations.
outcomes: Farm Budgeting And Cash Flow Projection
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of farm operations, agricultural supply chains, or agribusiness administration. No advanced finance or coding background is required, but you should be comfortable using spreadsheets for budgeting, record keeping, and basic analysis. The course is delivered at an intermediate level, so prior exposure to farming operations, commercial production, cooperative management, or agricultural business development will help you get more from the exercises. Laptop access is recommended for the budgeting and value chain mapping activities.
